events.title: New Years Eve Legends
events.desc: Ring in the new year with the Nitro New Year's Eve event! Celebrate the end of the year and start the new year with high-speed racing alongside the Nitro Type community. Participants will be competing for top honors, with 1,000,000 NT Cash awarded to first place, 500,000 NT Cash for second place, and 100,000 NT Cash for third place. Sharpen your typing skills, race your way onto the podium, and start the new year as a champion!

events.title: Nitro Christmas ❄️ - Championship
events.desc:
This event is part of a tournament. Championship for Nitro Christmas ❄️

Welcome to the Nitro Christmas tournament, hosted to celebrate the holiday season and the arrival of winter. Created to highlight outstanding Nitro Type teams and bring racers together, this competition features a total prize pool of 10M to 20M NT Cash distributed among the top finishers. Prepare your team, sharpen your typing skills, and join us for an exciting winter celebration.
